Card Q&A.a: This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.
Card Q&A.q: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can. It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. However, if an effect such as  is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.
Card Q&A.q: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?

Card Q&A.a: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.
Card Q&A.q: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?

Card Q&A.a: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.
Card Q&A.q: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?

Card Q&A.a: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: A card that has an "isn't affected by [...] effects" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?

Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
